subject: Recap & next steps: LogiHealth initial integration and PoC staffing
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Amara Singh <amara@logihealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: LogiHealth initial integration and PoC staffing

Amara — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard + suggested next steps so we have alignment before we lock timelines.

Key pain / goals (as described on call)
- Clinical triage latency: current system has unpredictable ~900ms median per-request spikes during peak hours, hurting UX.
- Costs are ballooning on current model-hosting; want to cut per-token cost and maintain response quality for clinical prompts.
- Need an onboarding path that doesn’t require cloud infra changes on your side (prefer network-safe API or private peering).

Current stack notes (what you said)
- Frontend: React-based web triage portal.
- Backend: Python (FastAPI) microservice calling vendor LLM endpoints; GCP us-central region.
- Auth: central API gateway + OAuth2; keys rotated monthly.

Success criteria for a 6-week PoC (our proposed working set)
- Avg latency improvement >= 25% at 95th percentile for 1k concurrent users
- Per-token cost reduction >= 30% relative to current run-rate
- No measurable drop in clinical prompt fidelity (we’ll run blind evals on 200-case set)

Suggested PoC scope & milestones
1) Week 0 (this week): NDA + SOW acknowledgement, high-level onboarding doc shared (attachment).
2) Week 1: Technical kickoff — API key exchange, test account, sample dataset ingestion for evals.
3) Week 2–3: Integration: SDK drop-in (Python + Node), quick e2e tests, latency benchmarking.
4) Week 4: Quality evaluation and tuning; prefix caching configuration.
5) Week 5–6: Load tests, final report, decision checkpoint.

Owners (Redwood / LogiHealth)
- Redwood: Tessa (eng lead, technical contact), Marissa (solutions engineer, evals), Ben (SRE for PoC infra).
- LogiHealth: Amara (product lead), Mark (CTO).

Technical notes / constraints
- SDKs we propose: python redwood==1.4.x and node @redwood/inference (both supported).
- Data residency: default us-central; if you need EU, we can route — please confirm compliance needs.
- Rate limits: we’ll provision a dedicated PoC key with elevated quotas.

Action items / asks from LogiHealth
- Confirm the 6-week PoC window and owners above by EOD Wed (15 Oct).
- Share a sample of 200 de-identified prompts/cases for our blind evals.
- Confirm whether your infra team prefers API over VPC peering for PoC.

Attachment: LogiHealth-Integration-Notes-20261012.pdf (PDF, 230KB) — contains meeting notes and proposed SOW draft.

If this aligns, I’ll set the kickoff for Monday (19 Oct) and drop the PoC key + SOW.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Tessa — useful summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Data residency: for the PoC we are fine in us-central, but for production we need to confirm HIPAA boundary controls and whether logs can be routed to our KMS. Can you confirm Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for private deployments?

2) Sample prompts: we’ll anonymize and hand off the 200-case set by Fri (16 Oct).

3) SDKs: Python is our primary backend language (FastAPI). Node is used in a couple of auxiliary services but not required for PoC.

4) Timeline: 6-week window sounds reasonable, but can we start the kickoff the week of Oct 26 instead? Our infra team is on a security sprint next week.

Also looping in Mark (CTO) to confirm infra expectations. Mark — any red flags on the above?

Appreciate the quick reply, Amara. Answers inline and a couple of adjustments to the plan.

- KMS / logs: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS for on-prem/private deployments; for hosted PoC we can set up envelope encryption and redact audit logs on request. If you want full KMS integration during PoC we can trial a scoped integration but it will add ~1–2 weeks to the infra prep.

- Kickoff timing: shifting the kickoff to week of Oct 26 is absolutely fine. Proposed updated milestones below to reflect that shift.

Updated PoC timeline (start Oct 26)
- Week 0 (Oct 26): Technical kickoff, NDA/SOW sign, PoC key provisioning.
- Week 1 (Nov 2): SDK drop-in + smoke tests (Python integration example included).
- Week 2–3 (Nov 9–22): Load bench & latency tuning.
- Week 4 (Nov 23): Quality evals on 200-case set.
- Week 5–6 (Nov 30–Dec 13): Final load run, report and decision.

SDK samples: will share a Python snippet and a small FastAPI example in the Drive doc. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cLogiHealth-POC

I’ve attached a concise PoC scope spreadsheet for your infra team (redwood-poc-scope-20261013.xlsx).

Can you confirm: (A) kickoff on Oct 26 works for your team and (B) who will be the primary infra contact (email) so we can provision the test key and set quotas?

Next meeting: I’ll propose a 30-min technical kickoff on Tue, Oct 27 at 10:00am PT — please accept or propose another time.

Attachment: redwood-poc-scope-20261013.xlsx (XLSX, 56KB)
